notes: Verified bit-for-bit vs the published 2.2.2 linux-x64 single-file. Nethermind is reproducible-by-design: digest-pinned SDK, ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true (CI=true in the Dockerfile), SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and -p:SourceRevisionId=COMMIT_HASH. We pin SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to the commit date so all rebuilders converge.
